theorems.name: Submission.c1_regular_level_slice_image_countablyRectifiable
theorems.statement: ∀ (m k N : ℕ) (D : Set (Rn (m + k))) (ψ : Rn (m + k) → Rn N) (G : Rn (m + k) → Rn m) (y : Rn m), IsOpen D → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ D → ContDiff ℝ 1 G → CountablyRectifiable k (ψ '' (D ∩ {u | Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ G u)} ∩ G ⁻¹' {y}))
